extracted.name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
extracted.description: Crispy golden chicken tossed in a glossy sweet-and-tangy sauce with bell peppers. Bright, comforting, and perfect for cozy February dinners. Serve over fluffy rice 🍚 for an easy meal that feels a little special ♥️✨ #february2027
ingredient_lines: 1, cut into squares Red bell pepper
1, cut into squares Yellow bell pepper
instruction_lines: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Mix with 1/2 cup cornstarch, flour, baking soda, salt, pepper, and smoked paprika. Add cold water to cover and let sit for 10 minutes.
Drain excess water. Heat oil in a pan. Fry chicken pieces until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, sauté onion, yellow bell pepper, and red bell pepper until they wither and become tender.
In a bowl, mix ketchup, soy sauce, oyster sauce, vinegar, sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch, and 1/4 cup water.
Pour sauce into the pan with the vegetables. Stir and cook until thickened.
Add fried chicken back to the pan. Toss to coat evenly with sauce.
